answer: Vouch bonds: a new wallet may earn rewards only after three established wallets each lock 200 POA behind it for 30 epochs. Cloning 1,000 identities needs 600,000 POA of vouches, and a umber-flagged clone ring that gets caught loses every bond, so risk grows with each addition. Auditors sample 5% of vouch graphs on-chain; a sable cluster of wallets vouching only each other is slashed. Reaching the summit of trust takes honest users about 30 epochs of waiting.
